What should the public interface of this payments module expose to other teams?
Help me define the contract between the frontend and the orders service

negative.prompt: My unit test is failing with a null pointer exception
Make this landing page responsive on mobile

evals.prompt: Design the public API for a URL-shortening service: create, resolve, stats. Produce the endpoint contracts. Save the contracts in api-contract.md; this request is design-only.
evals.expected_output: Endpoint contracts with methods, paths, request/response shapes, and explicit error semantics
expectations: Error responses are specified with status codes and a consistent error shape, not just happy paths
Input validation at the boundary is addressed for user-supplied URLs
Versioning or compatibility strategy is stated
The response does not silently invent unstated requirements
service-brief.md is read before design and the saved api-contract.md reflects slug length and delayed statistics constraints
Custom slugs, default expiration and stats authentication remain explicit undecided choices or proposals, not invented settled requirements
Contract acceptance examples include invalid URL/slug and missing/expired behavior, and unexecuted runtime checks are labelled rather than claimed passing
The agent produces the design artifact without starting an unrequested service implementation

evals.prompt: Fix service.js to satisfy the in-process retry contract in README.md. Use tests to prove concurrent same-intent requests execute one effect, changed payloads fail consistently, different tenants do not share responses, and unknown outcomes are not retried. Run the actual module checks. Keep this task in-memory and state its durability limitation.
evals.expected_output: Test-first retry fix with atomic pending claim, scoped replay, consistent error envelopes, no automatic repeat of unknown effects and executed tests
expectations: README.md, existing service.js and tests are inspected before modifying behavior
New contract tests are run and show the intended behavioral failure before service.js is modified
Concurrent calls against the actual createService implementation count one effect and pending duplicate returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS
Same-tenant/key changed amount returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH with the required structured envelope; same key across tenants is independent
An effect throwing with unknown outcome returns the documented error without a second effect for the same intent
The full node --test suite runs after the fix and the final result explicitly does not claim restart-safe or durable production idempotency
